statements.quote: Total income for FY26 was INR198.17 crores as against INR254.94 crores.
statements.target: FY26 revenue down 22% from previous year, no explicit upside guidance given.

statements.quote: Total expenditure in FY26 was INR124.09 crores as against INR108.44 crores for the previous financial year. Profit before tax for this year was INR74.07 crores as against INR146.50 crores and profit after tax was INR55.36 crores as against INR109.95 crores.
statements.target: Profit margin fell to 27.9% PAT of FY26, down from 43.4% in FY25; no new margin targets disclosed.

statements.quote: Technology and the employee-related expense have increased during the year. Should we expect that to continue over the next few years versus a large investment lead in future growth inactives?
statements.target: Management indicates continued investment in technology and people over the next few years, but no specific capex figure committed.

statements.quote: How many folios we would be having right now? And with the flurry of IPOs that we have seen in FY '26, what kind of folio additions are we expecting because we see a reset in the first quarter.
statements.target: No quantitative folio addition target disclosed; management acknowledges a reset but no numbers provided.

statements.quote: So far as CVL was concerned, the revenue from operations for FY26 was INR182 crores as compared to INR231 crores for the previous year. Other income was INR15 crores as against INR23 crores for the previous year.
statements.target: Operating revenue for CVL fell 21%; no new segment‑level guidance provided.

statements.quote: I think from 1st April onwards, that fetch rate has reduced from 35 to 28 and probably creation fees also to some extent. So, on a like-to-like basis, if you can help us with what exactly would be the rate impact, is it a 20% rate impact which we should build, assuming volumes remain same?
statements.target: No specific rate or fee adjustment target committed; management seeks confirmation of a 20% impact assumption.

statements.quote: Other income was INR15 crores as against INR23 crores for the previous year.
statements.target: No balance sheet guidance provided beyond current figures.

statements.quote: 24 crores demat accounts which we have right now is a number which has grown 5x in the last 5, 6 years, and which hence justifies our increase in technology till date.
statements.target: No quantitative commitment; management highlights historic growth to justify tech spend.
